title: Talking Heads Radio: Listen to the New SiriusXM Channel
summary: Talking Heads Radio launches October 1, featuring music, stories, and a rare conversation with all four band members.
body_markdown:
Acclaimed new wave pioneers Talking Heads bring you Talking Heads Radio, an exclusive SiriusXM pop-up channel celebrating more than 50 years of music from David Byrne, Chris Frantz, Jerry Harrison, and Tina Weymouth.


[Talking Heads Radio Songs, stories & specials Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTalkingHeadsRadio)


Available beginning October 1, the channel features the band’s biggest songs and deep cuts alongside exclusive stories, guest DJ sets, special commentary, and a rare conversation with all four members.


- **Related:[David Byrne Reveals His Favorite Classic Indie as Guest DJ on SiriusXMU](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/david-byrne-siriusxmu-old-school)**


## Talking Heads Radio on SiriusXM


### How to Listen


The channel is available to subscribers in their cars on Ch. 145 from October 1 through October 22 and on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTalkingHeadsRadio) from October 1 through October 31.


### What You’ll Hear


Celebrating over 50 years of music from Talking Heads, Talking Heads Radio features music and exclusive true stories from David Byrne, Chris Frantz, Jerry Harrison and Tina Weymouth. Listeners can hear the band’s favorite tracks and deep cuts from their legendary catalog alongside curated guest DJ sets from Adam Clayton, Nate Mendel, The Linda Lindas, Tunde Adebimpe, Trey Anastasio, and others, as well as special commentary from some of the band’s influences, the latest on upcoming projects, and more.


- **Related:[David Byrne Opens Up About Brian Eno and American Utopia on SiriusXM](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/david-byrne-talks-creative-contributions-on-working-with-brian-eno)**


### Talking Heads Front Row with All Four Band Members


In celebration of the new channel, all four members of Talking Heads made a rare appearance together to sit down in front of a live audience at SiriusXM’s New York City studios for an exclusive *Front Row* Q&A event hosted by Este Haim,[bass guitarist and vocalist from the band Haim](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/este-haim-adam-clayton) , on Monday, September 28 at 7pm ET.


The full conversation premieres on Talking Heads Radio on Thursday, October 1 at 12pm ET and is to available stream on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTalkingHeadsRadio) after its debut.


- **Related:[Listen to the Top 500 Songs of the 1980s, Ranked](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/best-80s-songs)**


SiriusXM’s *Front Row* series continues to bring fans closer to the biggest names in music and entertainment with this year’s lineup featuring the[cast of Toy Story 5](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/toy-story-5-front-row) , the[cast of The Devil Wears Prada 2](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/devil-wears-prada-2-cast-interview) ,[Olivia Rodrigo](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/olivia-rodrigo-weekend-takeover) , and many more.
